plugins.name: cache-weather-and-pause-resume
plugins.description: A band above the prompt: prompt-cache countdown and bar, an opt-in keep-warm that refreshes the cache before it runs out, hit rate, context weather with the auto-compact threshold, a Compact button and a Pause / Resume button. German and English.
